subject.title: refactor(prompt): use plain inbound context labels and drop system-tag sanitizer

question: Should OpenClaw replace sanitizer-based defanging of external system-looking text with the PR's renderer-plus-provenance-marker boundary for every queued system-event, gateway-hook, and inbound-context path?
rationale: This is a deliberate trust-boundary policy choice, not a mechanical rename: the patch removes a shared sanitizer and relies on final rendering behavior as its replacement control.

options.title: Confirm the renderer boundary
options.body: Approve the design after the responsible owner verifies that every prompt-reaching system-event path receives the final system prefix and cannot mint a separate trusted-looking line.

options.title: Retain a narrow sanitizer
options.body: Keep or restore sanitization at the shared queue and gateway boundaries if any prompt path can bypass the final renderer.

options.title: Split the refactor
options.body: Land only the label and SDK compatibility changes, then handle system-tag policy in a focused security-reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Confirm the renderer boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the design after the responsible owner verifies that every prompt-reaching system-event path receives the final system prefix and cannot mint a separate trusted-looking line.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has carried the proposed design and its compatibility follow-ups; confidence is limited because the supplied material does not identify a separate current-main security-boundary owner.
